decisions.reason: Using the supplied logo does not change the master site's location-selection, routing, navigation, or booking-ownership behavior.

The logo is owned by the shared brand-identity Requirement and does not change the candidate's layout, style, reference, or brand-impression attributes; it also does not resolve the new-style ambiguity.
The logo decision does not change the booking platform, Seattle booking status, or booking activation behavior.
Brand-logo usage does not alter the required separation of location accounts, data, analytics, access, or operational tracking.
The supplied logo does not change the reusable template structure or future-location onboarding rules, and the source does not establish a new template customization policy.
The logo decision does not change which domain is assigned to the master site.
